def similar_elements(list1, list2):
    # Use zip to compare elements at the same index and find common elements
    shared_elements = [x for i, x in enumerate(list1) if i < len(list2) and list2[i] == x]
    return tuple(shared_elements)

# Test the function with provided data points
assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set([4])
